request: One shared guide login per operator, restricted to Simple View passenger counts and trip photos
setup: Settings > Admin Users > Guide login > Create guide login. Owner shares the private one-use, 48-hour setup link. Guide chooses a shared password and signs straight into Simple View.
access_model: Separate guide_accounts identity; no admin_users row or office tenant grants. Dedicated tenant-bound RPCs expose passenger totals and photos. Photo uploads use the verified guide identity and the existing operator Drive connection.

browser.scope: Synthetic isolated preview: guide sign-in, office-route blocking including forged role cookie, trip-photo viewing/upload, password setup and owner setup-link creation

validation.database: Passed in disposable local PostgreSQL: own-tenant scope, zero office booking grants, operator-timezone aggregation, cancelled booking exclusion, private token columns, denied direct storage writes, identity separation, one-use setup claim, invalid identity and replay rejection, suspension and subscription enforcement
validation.visual: Reviewed 390px mobile Simple View screenshot; sign-out and primary navigation remain readable with touch-sized controls
validation.broader_changed_file_lint: One existing operator Simple View Date.now render purity error at app/simple/page.tsx:31, plus existing warnings. Guide-specific branch and new feature files pass lint. Existing operator code was not changed to address this unrelated issue.

external_changes: None for guide access. No real guide users, passwords, customer emails, provider uploads or hosted database changes were created.
